description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing 'corrective actions' in a manufacturing quality management system. It includes API endpoints for retrieving, updating, deleting, and changing the status of corrective actions, with role-based access control and Swagger API documentation.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a corrective action by ID, requiring authentication.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a corrective action by ID, restricted to 'Quality Engineer' role.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a corrective action by ID, restricted to 'Production Supervisor' role.

methods.name: router.patch('/:id/status')
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to change the status of a corrective action, restricted to 'Quality Engineer' role.
